verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no pricing-tier documentation. It does not state a concurrent-session cap per plan or the cost to raise that cap. The only related item is a marketing claim about spinning up 'thousands of concurrent browser sessions', which describes scale in general rather than tier-specific limits or upgrade pricing, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I know the maximum concurrent sessions or requests allowed on my pricing tier and the cost to raise that cap
